title: Tech stories can still be entered, edited and required
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the Work Orders build under test as a user whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit. To check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > Work Orders (an Owner or Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, pick the location you will test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty") and stay in it for the whole case.
  3. Create a customer used only by this case so a search shows only its work orders: Customers > New Customer, name (e.g. "ZZ Board Test Co"), add an asset with a unit number and year/make/model (e.g. unit "TRK-118", "2022 Freightliner M2"), then Save.
  4. Create an Approved work order for the case customer with two lines, "Line 1" and "Line 2", and a mileage entered on the work order.
custom_steps:
1. On the Lines tab, add a tech story to Line 1 (e.g. "First note") and save.
  2. Edit Line 1's story to "First note, edited" and save.
  3. Try to complete Line 2 without a tech story.
  4. Add a tech story to Line 2 and complete it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Entering and editing the story work as before and the edited text shows.
  • Completing a line without a tech story is still blocked with today's message (a tech story is required), and works once the story is entered. Nothing else about tech stories changed; only the check mark is gone.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10051 (Story 8, Remove the tech story check-mark indicator); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S8-R2, read 8 Oct 2026. Source-verified 8 October 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R2: “Entering, editing, or requiring a tech story continues to work exactly as today; only the indicator is removed.”
